elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if that person supplies or offers to supply any article that may be used or adapted to be used (whether by itself or in combination with another article or other articles) in the administration of a controlled drug by any person to himself or another, believing that the article (or the article as adapted) is to be so used in circumstances where the administration is unlawful.
